<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On May 25, 2023, the Company entered into a Loan
Agreement with ADSB for a total of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--NotesPayable_iI_c20230525__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zuAoUMioBYnd">7,000,000</span>
which is zero-interest bearing. The loan was issued in connection with <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding_iI_c20230525__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zhsqxtRU5Md7">5,687,500</span>
detached warrants which are immediately exercisable at a price of CAD$<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_uCADPShares_c20230525__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember_ziyYphVlTHc3">0.80</span>
per share (USD $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_uUSDPShares_c20230525__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember_zdmZWnDx5Zae">0.60</span>)
for a period of 60 months from the date of issuance. Upon full repayment of the loan, which is expected in 2028 the Company will transfer
<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--RepaymentsOfDebt_c20230525__20230525__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAUnitsMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--LenderMember_zbUBxKTvl801">720,000</span>
Class A Units of ADSB to the lender. Both the warrants and the ADSB transfer were determined to create a debt discount totaling $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscount_iI_c20230525__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zKhLEWfUsS3b">3,809,659</span>
that is amortized over the term of the loan. During the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, amortization of the debt discount of
$<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zsdJgHbniUYh">993,024</span>
and $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zDYhX0lIXM87">993,824</span>,
respectively, were recorded. On February 27, 2026, Anderson Development SB, LLC, a subsidiary of the Company, entered into Amendment
No. 1 to its Loan Agreement and Promissory Note Secured by Deed of Trust with Arbor Ranch SB, LLC (the &#8220;Lender&#8221;), originally
dated May 25, 2023, pursuant to which the Lender had loaned the Borrower up to $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_c20260227__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zIcsfgYAbHZ3" title="Borrowed amount">7,000,000</span>. The Amendment modifies the repayment schedule,
providing for twelve monthly installments of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment_c20260227__20260227__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_z3nwYuIHBIQ7" title="Periodic payment">50,000</span> for calendar year 2026, totaling $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentPrincipal_c20260227__20260227__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zvjmoYlLbSei" title="Periodic payment principal">600,000</span>, with the first payment of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentPrincipal_c20260315__20260315__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zUAwGaQf63ge" title="Periodic payment principal">150,000</span> due
March 15, 2026 (covering January, February, and March 2026). Normal repayment terms resume January 1, 2027, and the Borrower shall make
a one-time catch-up payment of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--RepaymentsOfOtherDebt_c20270830__20270830__srt--StatementScenarioAxis__srt--ScenarioForecastMember_zjfbcvuxAeL6" title="Repayments of other debt">484,638</span> on August 30, 2027. The Lender also waived all events of default existing as of the date of the
Amendment. Concurrently, the Company amended and restated a warrant to purchase common stock originally issued to James Shields on May
25, 2023, reducing the exercise price to CAD$0.30 per share and extending the exercise period by <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingWeightedAverageRemainingContractualTerm2_dc_c20230525__20230525_zW8Sqw6GyGgf" title="Contractual term">five years</span> from February 27, 2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On September 30, 2023, the Company entered into
a Loan Agreement with the Salisbury Canyon Ranch, LLC for a total of $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--NotesPayable_iI_c20230930__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--SalisburyCanyonRanchLLCMember_zecvJCAZHa4a">4,199,000</span> which bears interest at <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_c20230930__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--LoanAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--SalisburyCanyonRanchLLCMember_za313iecigZj">4</span>% per annum. The Company will
make interest-only payments for a period of three years at which point blended interest and principal payments will be made for an additional
two years, with a balloon payment due at that time.</p>

<tr><td class="hide"><a style="color: white;" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.hideAR();">X</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for information about short-term and long-term debt arrangements, which includes amounts of borrowings under each line of credit, note payable, commercial paper issue, bonds indenture, debenture issue, own-share lending arrangements and any other contractual agreement to repay funds, and about the underlying arrangements, rationale for a classification as long-term, including repayment terms, interest rates, collateral provided, restrictions on use of assets and activities, whether or not in compliance with debt covenants, and other matters important to users of the financial statements, such as the effects of refinancing and noncompliance with debt covenants.</p></div>
